intro: I’m Abolfazl, a front-end developer based in Tehran, working with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. I build product interfaces, admin panels, and brand websites, with a particular interest in motion and interactive 3D experiences.

At Avan Tech, I develop customer and admin workflows. As co-founder and technical lead at Worldbuilderzzz, I lead end-to-end development of the team’s products and websites. I handled all programming for WePackaging and Fash Ba Tashdid, from the first interaction to individual project pages.

highlights: Expanded Madar Market’s customer account with wallet withdrawal requests, product returns and tracking, transaction history, notifications, and order cancellation. Improved admin tools for homepage sections and promotions.
Built Talaresoon’s admin interfaces for orders, product variants, customers, categories, and dashboards, plus product listing and category routes for the mobile client.
Lead end-to-end technical implementation of the team’s products, brand websites, and landing pages, across front-end and back-end development.

contact: I’m open to full-time front-end roles, on-site or remote. If your team is hiring, I’d like to hear what you’re building.
